source.title: FinRL-X: An AI-Native Modular Infrastructure for Quantitative Trading

summary: FinRL-X (March 2026) is the successor to FinRL — fully modernized for LLM + agentic AI era. Supports ML-based stock selection, professional backtesting, and live brokerage execution. More modular than original FinRL; explicitly designed to be 'deployment-aware'. Could be a better foundation for H204 than the original FinRL/stable-baselines3 path.
actionable: Before implementing H204 from scratch with stable-baselines3, check FinRL-X first. It may provide a pre-built gym environment for US equity PPO that's better calibrated than writing our own. The AI4Finance-Foundation/FinRL-Trading GitHub repo has the implementation. Compare to our planned H204 approach: PPO on SPY daily returns, IS 2003-2020, OOS 2021-2026.
